thread:
Maria: Quick pulse for CedarCo — weekly health snapshot. Focus: token consumption, peak throughput, p95 latency, 5xx errors, spend. TL;DR: tokens +8% WoW, +22% QoQ; p95 latency +120ms WoW; 5xx 0.2% -> 0.5% in last 48h; spend +12% WoW.
Aj: Onboarding update — CedarCo is in phase 2 ramp. They flipped to streaming for chat last Tue which explains token surge. Onboarding still on track but watch spend.
Sam: Noted a brief throughput dip in us-west at ~03:12 UTC — eviction event. Log snippet: ```2026-03-14T03:12:07Z ERROR slot-12 OOM serving model-v3.1``` Fallback to model-v2 for ~6m, throughput recovered.
deploy-bot: Deployed model v3.1 to us-west (canary) at 2026-03-14T02:50Z.
Maria: Endpoint split for CedarCo this week: /chat 68%, /rerank 20%, /embed 12%. Peak TPS measured 420 (15m), baseline 260 — WoW spike driven by new streaming usage.
Leo: Heads-up: renewal discussion in Q3. If spend trend continues they may ask for committed-discount or throttle. We need a cost-optimization plan to present in the renewal playbook.
Aj: Scheduling enablement + billing walk-through w/ CedarCo PM — Wed 11am PT. Draft email + pre-read uploaded: https://console.redwood/in/orgs/cedarco/usage (shareable).
Sam: Proposed short-term mitigations: enable prefix KV caching on their dedicated pool; reduce per-request max_tokens from 1024 -> 512 for non-critical endpoints; apply per-route batching windows of 40ms. Estimated token reduction 18-25% and p95 latency improvement ~30-50ms.
Maria: Quality check: we should run evals on a representative prompt set after caching + token cap. I'll spin up a small eval job and link results to the dashboard.
Leo: Also capture customer feedback — they mentioned occasional truncated responses after switching to streaming. Could be a token limit/config mismatch. @Aj please capture examples in the pre-read.
Aj: Will collect 3 representative truncated prompts before Wed and add to meeting notes.
Sam: Action: I'll roll caching to CedarCo's ded pool as a canary tonight at 22:00 PT, monitor for regressions, rollback plan ready.
Maria: Owners: @Sam = implement caching + monitor; @Aj = send invite + pre-read (include truncated examples); @Leo = own renewal conversation & quantify risk. I'll create a follow-up thread with eval results.
Leo: :thumbsup: thanks all.
Maria: Quick numbers snapshot (WoW / QoQ): tokens/day 1.2M (+8% / +22%), avg p95 latency 420ms (+120ms / +60ms QoQ), 5xx rate 0.5% (up from 0.2%), weekly spend $12.4k (+12% WoW).
Sam: Will post condensed post-mortem if the eviction traces point to autoscaler settings.
Aj: I'll prep the deck for Wed and run the usage optimization checklist.
Maria: End of thread — will update after the canary rollout and eval.
